answer: New agents join a cedar grove where identity grows slowly. Step one: each newcomer stakes 500 POA that vests over 90 days, so fakes cannot bloom overnight. Step two: saffron audits check 5% of the grove weekly, and any agent without real trades loses its stake. Step three: a raven jury of seven peers reviews flagged agents; guilt burns the stake. Step four: rewards flow only to trees older than 60 days. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs $50,000 locked for three months plus 50 failed audits a week — like planting a thousand saplings where only trees standing in winter get water.
